pages.title: Modifiers
pages.text: $(l)Punch$(): Punch I by default. $(l)Agility$(): walk at full speed while drawing. $(l)Speedy$(): Speed II for 1.5s after firing. $(l)Amphibious$(): less drag underwater. $(l)Slow Fall$(): slow-falling while aiming mid-air. $(l)Ignited$(): Flame by default. $(l)No Gravity$(): arrows fly perfectly straight.
